name: @absolutejs/queue-redis
description: Redis-backed JobStore for @absolutejs/queue. Atomic Lua claim, sorted-set scheduling by runAt, per-job hash records. For shops running Redis instead of (or alongside) Postgres.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun --external @absolutejs/queue && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run build && bun publish
